cell_identity: Samsung-labelled 18650 ICR "4000 mAh" 3.7 V cell as tested by the BMS team; electrical model and capacity from Nancy Zayour and Nagham El Ghossein pulse characterization (investigator instruction 2026-11-06; relabelling accepted).
cell_capacity_source: Nancy manuscript (References/battery-manuscript.tex): 2 Ah nominal; 0.5C 6-minute pulses each remove 5% SOC from 100% to 5% with OCV reaching 3.03 V, i.e. about 1.9 Ah measured to 5%, consistent with 2 Ah rather than the 4000 mAh label.
cell_table_policy: Nancy-characterized our params.xlsx OCV/3RC table and 2 Ah capacity used exactly as identified; no rescaling.
sizing_criterion: Investigator decision 2026-11-06 (9S1P) for the 1.2 m/s command envelope, by an outcome-independent rule: smallest series count of Nancy 2 Ah cell (1P) that sustains the efficient trot 0.8-1.0 m/s at every operating SOC. Development 60 s holds replayed on 2 Ah cells: 1.0 m/s passes on 9S from 25%/50%/95% (+0.29/+1.13/+2.73 V) and fails on 8S at 95%; 1.1 m/s passes on 9S only at high SOC (+1.14 V at 95%, -0.01 V at 50%); 1.2 m/s diverges on any pack. 8S1P is the planned ablation.
selection_evidence: Development probes BeyondTorque-Local-Artifacts/speed-ladder-development-20261106-a (ladder and 60 s holds); clean native qualification recorded in RL-MPC-Monitor/runs/tracked-swing-18650-20261105-a.
